title: Cross-validate: SenML parity
close_reason: Cross-validated SenML-CBOR parity against test/vectors/senml_location.json on both sides. Rust side had three real divergences, all fixed: (1) upstream senml-cbor 0.1 encoder always emits bt/t as 9-byte f64 while the oracle pins shortest-form CBOR integers for whole-second timestamps (Python/cbor2 reference behavior) — added rust/lichen-senml/src/wire.rs canonical encoder (integral i64-window bt/t -> shortest-form int; v always f64; bn,bt,n,u,v,vs,vb,t label order; up-front validation: one-of value fields, 128-byte name cap, finite-only). (2) upstream decoder rejects integer heads wider than 2 bytes, so it could not even read the committed vectors — wire.rs now carries a full no_std decoder (all definite arg widths incl 0x1a/0x1b ints, f16/f32/f64, unknown-key skip with depth guard, duplicate-key reject, trailing-byte reject) plus the RFC 8428 4.2 one-of rule matching Python unpack. (3) Position::to_senml_cbor accepted out-of-range/non-finite coordinates that Python profiles.location rejects — pos.rs now enforces F.3 lat/lon bounds and finiteness (converged with parallel worker's concurrent edits). New tests: lichen-senml/tests/location_vectors.rs (6 cross-language tests: byte-exact encode parity on all 5 positive vectors, decode field parity, re-encode stability vs oracle bytes, NaN encode reject, all 3 decode rejects, partition check) + 13 wire unit tests incl RFC 8949 A.1 literals; lichen-client/tests/position_senml_vectors.rs (4 client-level parity tests, fixed 2 borrow-compile errors in parallel worker's draft). Validation: cargo test -p lichen-senml -p lichen-client = 27+91 tests green across 11 suites; clippy clean (one pre-existing warning in presence_vectors.rs left for its owner); fmt applied; python pytest location-vectors+senml suites 97 passed. Findings NOT in scope, reported here instead of new beads: lichen-gateway resources.rs encode_nodes_senml emits SenML-CBOR with STRING labels ('bn'/'n'/'t') via ciborium — RFC 8428 section 6 requires integer labels in the CBOR form; needs its own fix. Python tests/senml/test_relative_time.py cannot collect in this env (lora-medium git dep not installed) — pre-existing.
